rules.rule: When filling or removing wall openings/doors, match ambient shadow gradient and paint finish continuously with zero hard boundaries.
Always extend floor baseboard skirting smoothly across any removed doorframe opening matching adjacent color, height, and profile.
100% preserve adjacent corridors, background rooms, kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, ceilings, and flooring textures untouched.
Never render rectangular or isolated cutout patches; diffuse lighting and texture smoothly into surrounding plaster.

antiPatterns: Abrupt luminance steps between newly filled wall surfaces and existing ambient shadows.
Discontinuous baseboard or trim lines where doorways previously existed.
Accidental cropping or alteration of distant open rooms (e.g. kitchens, corridors).
